headline: Magnolia Oceanside requests extension of alcohol service area for food and alcohol during Magtoberfest on October 11, 2026.
summary: The board will consider a request from Larry Rodolosi of Magnolia Oceanside, dba Magnolia 525 Tavern, to extend his alcohol service area to serve food and alcohol on October 11, 2026 during Magtoberfest.
items: Extension of Premise: Larry Rodolosi of Magnolia Oceanside, dba Magnolia 525 Tavern, requests to extend alcohol service area to serve food and alcohol on October 11, 2026 during Magtoberfest
